customRules.title: Production-impacting infra command
customRules.detail: Terraform, kubectl, and Helm commands can change live systems or delete resources.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Confirm target environment, review the plan/diff, and name the rollback path.

customRules.title: IAM permission widening
customRules.detail: Wildcard IAM actions or resources can grant more access than intended.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Narrow actions and resources before applying.

customRules.title: Public infrastructure exposure
customRules.detail: Public networking or storage settings can expose infrastructure or data.
customRules.suggestedCheck: Restrict the source, bucket, service, or network rule and document the intended exposure.
